title: Starbucks Uncap, Scan, & Win Sweepstakes
prize: Participate in the Starbucks Uncap, Scan, & Win Sweepstakes for a chance to win free Starbucks food or drinks for a year, or instant win prizes such as 60 or 25 Stars, free handcrafted beverages, and bakery item coupons. How To Enter: During the sweepstakes period, visit https://uncapstars.starbuck
eligibilityText: Eligibility: Open only to legal residents of the fifty (50) United States and the District of Columbia, who are eighteen (18) years of age or older at the time of entry.
